This season saw the merging of the ISL with the [[Indonesian Premier League]] (IPL) after three years of dualism. It was decided that only four teams from the Premier League would join the new Super League.{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/indochamp.html |title=Indonesia - List of (Semi-)Professional Champions |last=Atsushi Fujioka and Novan Herfiyana |date=16 January 2014 |access-date=13 February 2014 |url-status=live |website=[[RSSSF]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120521104614/http://www.rsssf.com/tablesi/indochamp.html |archive-date=21 May 2012 }} The 22 clubs were divided into two groups (regions) so that each group contained eleven participating teams; this was due to the many political agenda in Indonesia in 2014 such as the parliamentary election on 9 April 2014 and the presidential election on 9 July 2014.{{cite web|title=PSSI pastikan kompetisi ISL musim depan digelar dua wilayah|url=http://www.bola.net/indonesia/pssi-pastikan-kompetisi-isl-musim-depan-digelar-dua-wilayah-af499b.html|work=bola.net|publisher=PSSI|access-date=28 October 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131031051850/http://www.bola.net/indonesia/pssi-pastikan-kompetisi-isl-musim-depan-digelar-dua-wilayah-af499b.html|archive-date=31 October 2013|url-status=live}} ==Teams== Indonesia Super League was followed by 22 clubs consisting of ''fourteen Super League teams'', ''four teams of the Premier League'', ''three Premier Division teams'' and ''one team winning the play-off'' between ranked 15th Super League and ranked 4th Premier Division.{{cite web|last=Afroni|first=Donny|title=Liga tetap bernama Indonesia Super League|url=http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2013/03/17/3832442/liga-tetap-bernama-indonesia-super-league|work=goal.com|access-date=17 March 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130320032002/http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2013/03/17/3832442/liga-tetap-bernama-indonesia-super-league|archive-date=20 March 2013|url-status=dead}} [[PSPS Pekanbaru]], [[Persidafon Dafonsoro]] and [[Persiwa Wamena]] were relegated during the end of the [[2013 Indonesia Super League|Previous]] season. Four teams of the [[2013 Indonesian Premier League]] would participate: [[Semen Padang F.C.|Semen Padang]], [[Persiba Bantul]], [[Persijap Jepara]] and [[PSM Makassar]]. The whole composition of the 22 teams above was decided by the [[PSSI]] executive committee members that were qualified as participants in the [[Indonesia Super League]] at a meeting held on 10 December 2013 at The Sultan Hotel, Jakarta. But the composition was still provisional because some clubs still had to resolve their financial problems. If not completed, they were then dropped from the competition.{{cite web|title=Inilah 22 Klub yang Lolos Verifikasi|url=http://www.bolaindo.com/2013/12/10/inilah-22-klub-yang-lolos-verifikasi/|work=bolaindo.com|access-date=10 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131214065042/http://www.bolaindo.com/2013/12/10/inilah-22-klub-yang-lolos-verifikasi/|archive-date=14 December 2013|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}}{{cite web|title=25 Klub Verifikasi Dinyatakan Tak Bisa Lengkapi Lima Aspek Lisensi Profesional|url=http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2013/12/10/4468781/25-klub-verifikasi-dinyatakan-tak-bisa-lengkapi-lima-aspek?ICID=AR_RA_1|work=goal.com|access-date=10 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150226125019/http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2013/12/10/4468781/25-klub-verifikasi-dinyatakan-tak-bisa-lengkapi-lima-aspek?ICID=AR_RA_1|archive-date=26 February 2015|url-status=dead}}{{cite web|title=Sembilan Klub Tak Bisa Penuhi Aspek Finansial|url=http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2013/12/10/4468878/sembilan-klub-tak-bisa-penuhi-aspek-finansial?ICID=SP|work=goal.com|access-date=10 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131213073247/http://www.goal.com/id-ID/news/1387/nasional/2013/12/10/4468878/sembilan-klub-tak-bisa-penuhi-aspek-finansial?ICID=SP|archive-date=13 December 2013|url-status=dead}} In addition, PSSI also gave an opportunity for the three clubs ([[Perseman Manokwari]], [[Persepar Palangkaraya]] and [[Pro Duta F.C.|Pro Duta]]) that were not included in the composition of the participants had been decided by PSSI to make an appeal. PSSI and PT Liga Indonesia officially announced the 22 clubs were eligible to enter the Indonesia Super League (ISL) next season. See [https://web.archive.org/web/20140301165130/http://www.artikel.web.id/berita/jadwal-isl-2014-lengkap-hasil-isl-terbaru.html 2014 ISL schedule].{{cite web|title=PSSI Tetapkan 22 Klub Peserta Penyatuan Liga 2014|url=http://www.bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/57941-PSSI-Tetapkan-22-Klub-Peserta-Penyatuan-Liga-2014.html|work=bolanews.com|access-date=23 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131224115859/http://www.bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/57941-PSSI-Tetapkan-22-Klub-Peserta-Penyatuan-Liga-2014.html|archive-date=24 December 2013|url-status=usurped}} The announcement of next season's participants was done by PSSI secretary general Joko Driyono in the office of PT Liga Indonesia in Kuningan Place, [[Kuningan City|Kuningan]], [[South Jakarta]] on Monday, 23 December 2013.{{cite web|title=ISL Musim Depan Dua Wilayah, Diikuti 22 Klub|url=http://www.bolaindo.com/2013/12/23/isl-musim-depan-dua-wilayah-diikuti-22-klub/|work=bolaindo.com|access-date=23 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131224122306/http://www.bolaindo.com/2013/12/23/isl-musim-depan-dua-wilayah-diikuti-22-klub/|archive-date=24 December 2013|url-status=dead|df=dmy-all}} With the 22 participants of the ISL, then certainly for the next season, the highest caste of Indonesian football league was divided into two areas/groups, with each area comprising 11 clubs.{{cite web|title=LSI Musim 2014 Dibagi Menjadi Dua Wilayah|url=http://www.bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/57940-LSI-Musim-2014-Dibagi-Menjadi-Dua-Wilayah.html|work=bolanews.com|access-date=23 December 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131224115855/http://www.bolanews.com/read/sepakbola/indonesia/57940-LSI-Musim-2014-Dibagi-Menjadi-Dua-Wilayah.html|archive-date=24 December 2013|url-status=usurped}} ===Stadium and locations=== {{location map+ |Indonesia |float=none |width=800 |caption=Locations of the teams in the 2014 Indonesia Super League.
